breakdown.description: Inviscid simulation requested but top wall uses noSlip; inviscid wall should not impose no-slip viscous condition
breakdown.reason: The user's request implied a contradiction by asking for an inviscid simulation but using a noSlip (viscous) boundary condition for the top wall. The agent correctly resolved this by changing the top wall velocity boundary condition to 'slip', which is the appropriate condition for an inviscid wall.
